flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_REFINE
flags.meaning: Read at import of dsv41_r4_small (module-level bool) and validated by dsv41_head_r6 at import (ValueError on other values). On: certified_logits(full=False) runs _r6_xnorm (live body + list-counter zero) -> screen -> _r6_cand (live tile predicate per row or per 16-row tile, -inf fill, compact list) -> _r6_refine (persistent grid, live op sequence per listed row). tile: output bit-identical to live; row: computed logits bit-identical, other rows -inf, argmax-identical by the CERT certificate.

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_SCREEN
flags.meaning: r6 screen kernel: live _screen_kernel with the exact integer dequant (DSV41_R6_HEAD_SCREEN_DQ=1|2). HI and THR bit-identical (exhaustive dequant proof; device bitwise at every M). Falls back to the live screen when the CERT table has an exponent byte outside 1..254 (checked once).

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_SCREEN_DQ
flags.meaning: 1: cvt.rn.bf16 of the exact product; 2: top 16 bits of the exact product. Both proven equal to live for every (q, e) the builder emits.

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_SCREEN_CFG
flags.on_value: BN,BK,warps,stages copied from an 'ELIGIBLE-ENV screen' line (with DSV41_R6_HEAD_SCREEN_DQ=2)
flags.meaning: r6 screen launch shape; 0 = live value. Any non-zero field REQUIRES DSV41_R6_HEAD_SCREEN_DQ=2 (ValueError at import otherwise: the device sweep runs non-default shapes with DQ2 only). Applies at BM <= SWEPT_MAX_B=128 (every bucket the sweep runs: M 2/7/24/48/96 -> BM 16/16/32/64/128); above it the live shape serves. Use only a config device_test.py printed as an ELIGIBLE-ENV line.

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_REFINE_CFG
flags.on_value: BK,0,stages,grid,spread copied from an 'ELIGIBLE-ENV refine' line
flags.meaning: r6 refine: BK/stages 0 = live XBK/XSTAGES and act at BMX 16 only; warps MUST be 0 (live XWARPS; ValueError otherwise, the sweep does not vary it); grid 0 = 4 x SMs (192 on GB10); spread 1 = rows per chunk clamp(ceil(n/grid),1,16). grid/spread act at every BMX <= SWEPT_MAX_B=128 (the sweep runs one M per BMX bucket 16/32/64/128); above it grid 0 and spread 1 serve. Use only an 'ELIGIBLE-ENV refine' line.

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_CAND_ROWS
flags.meaning: rows per _r6_cand_kernel CTA at BMX 16 (halved per BMX doubling).

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_SELFCHECK
flags.meaning: first eager call per M runs the live pass too and compares (HI/THR bits; tile output bits; row output == where(predicate, live, -inf) + list length; argmax). One host sync per new M. Failure: ERROR log, live result, r6 off for the process (rank-local; no collective involved). Speed arms: SELFCHECK=0 once the device test and the hcheck arm (SELFCHECK=1) are clean, or warm every served M before measuring (each new M costs one extra head pass + host syncs).

flags.name: DSV41_R6_HEAD_STATS_EVERY
flags.meaning: every N r6 calls one host read and a log line: rows computed per call vs live-equivalent tiles per call (the rows-vs-tiles evidence for the refine lever). 0 = no reads.
